title: FONDANT FOR SOFT CHOCOLATE CREAMS
instructions: 1/3 a cup of glucose ( pure corn syrup ),

Put the sugar,  glucose and water over the fire and stir until boiling, then wash down the sides of the saucepan, cover and finish cooking as in making ordinary fondant. Let cook to 238&#176; F. Turn the syrup onto a damp marble or platter and before it becomes cold turn to a cream with a wooden spatula. When the fondant begins to stiffen, scrape at once into a bowl and cover with a damp cloth, but do not let the cloth touch the fondant. Use this fondant in the following recipes.
